response.sql: WITH t AS (SELECT team_id, SUM(games) AS total_home_games FROM home_game GROUP BY team_id) SELECT team_id, total_home_games, total_home_games * 1.0 / (SELECT SUM(total_home_games) FROM t) AS share_of_all_home_games, total_home_games * 1.0 / (SELECT AVG(total_home_games) FROM t) AS ratio_to_average FROM t ORDER BY ratio_to_average DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10

assumptions.assumption: The 'average number of home games' is the average of the per-team totals (mean of each team_id's summed games), so the ratio compares each team's total to the typical team total.
Home games come from home_game.games, summed per team_id across all years, parks and leagues; NULLs are ignored by SUM. Share is the team's total divided by the sum over all teams.
Ties at the 10th position are broken arbitrarily by LIMIT 10.

alternatives.interpretation: The average is the mean games value per home_game row (per team-season-park record), not the mean of team totals.
